title: Not customizable
body:
I liked the idea this app had originally. However it is frustrating. You have zero ability to customize anything. For example the water tracker. It only uses liters, no changing the unit. And it’s preset measurements, can’t enter your own. Same for the food. You can’t just track what you ate, your forced to provide a photo from your own gallery or take one and forced to add calories. It also has preset “daily” tasks like reading, working out, affirmations. You can’t turn them off. Can’t add different ones. The only thing you have input with is the scheduler but according to other reviews that doesn’t function well either. And not a big issue, but there’s not really a profile, can’t personalize the account whatsoever really. You pay money upfront, to not even have something personal.

Has great potential, not user friendly.

body:

title: Too many issues
body: I LOVE this app, but there’s a lot of improvement left. For one, why won’t reminders carry over day-to-day? It is such a waste of time to set reminders for every item each day. Second, there needs to be more customizability with the tasks we add. Third, I still notice some bugs, like some links not working.
